_comment: FT-12. Every price the site asserts, in one place. tools/check-prices.mjs verifies that no page states a price this file does not, so a stale figure fails the build instead of becoming a structured-data mismatch and, for a paid course sold in Australia, a consumer-law problem. Change a price here and in the page copy together; the check will tell you if you miss one.

course._note: The self-paced course. Asserted in JSON-LD on the homepage and all ten audience pages.

group._note: REMOVED FROM THE SITE 11 Aug 2026. These were placeholder figures invented by an AI session on 13 June 2026 (commit 1fae66a) with no costing behind them, and they sat live on the homepage for two months. Nothing ever charged them: the group tiers have always gone to the contact form and Stripe has no group price ID. Kept here as a record of what was shown, NOT as prices. The site now says every group is quoted. Put real numbers back only once they are costed, and add them to the 'group' block below so the price check starts guarding them again.

book._note: REMOVED FROM THE SITE 27 Sep 2026. Naomi took both earlier Kindle books down; the Complete Edition has no price yet, so the site states none. The old Kindle listing was A$9.89. When the new edition has a price, add it back here as "amazon" and on /book/ together, and reconcile by hand against the live listing.

prose_examples._note: Dollar figures that appear in article or page prose as examples, not as anything we charge. Listed so the price check does not flag them and so a real price can never hide among them.
